overview: This one-page file consists of an unrestricted covering despatch from the United States Political Adviser for Japan in Tokyo, dated December 18, 1946, transmitting four copies of a report on Japan’s limestone, lime, and gypsum resources to the U.S. Department of State. The enclosed Report No. 60, dated November 15, 1946, was prepared by the Natural Resources Section of General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, but the report itself is not included in the supplied OCR.

subfiles.summary: The United States Political Adviser for Japan forwards four copies of Report No. 60, dated November 15, 1946, to the Department of State. Entitled “Limestone, Lime, and Gypsum Resources in Japan,” the report was prepared by the Natural Resources Section of General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, and is described as containing an adequate prefatory summary. The document is marked unrestricted and records that an original and rectograph were sent to the Department.

interest: The document provides a concise archival trail showing how technical surveys produced by the Allied occupation authorities were transmitted to Washington. It identifies a specific Natural Resources Section report, its date, title, distribution, and security status, making it useful for tracing occupation-era assessments of Japan’s extractive resources even though the report itself is absent from the supplied file.
